by <custom data-type="mention" data-id="id-7">@bassem mohamed</custom> 

## **Acceptance critera:**

* Breadcrumbs with light mode 
* Breadcrumbs with dark mode

## **Technical details:**

_**organisms/BreadcrumbItem**_

```
export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id:string
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  subitems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}
```

* this component is used to render the single breadcrumb item and when hovering a dropdown is displayed if it has subitems 
* use `LuiText` , `LuiNavigationMenuTextItem` , `LuiDropdown` for rendering the dropdown on hover (desktop-only)

_**organisms/Breadcrumbs**_

```
export interface BreadcrumbProps {
  colorMode : 'on-light' | 'on-dark'
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
}
```

The difference in layout between mobile and desktop has to be implement with css only, to not cause any layout-shifts when loading the page. Interaction can of course be done with js.

### Storybook stories

Create these stories:

* 4 levels deep with level 1, level 2 and level 3 having a dropdown-menu
* 2 levels deep with level 1 having a dropdown-menu

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Breadcrumbs component provides essential wayfinding for shoppers navigating category and product pages. It displays the full hierarchical path from the homepage to the current page, enabling users to quickly understand their location within the store structure and navigate back to parent categories.

## Use Cases

- Display the complete category path on product listing pages (e.g., Home > Women > Shoes > Sneakers)
- Provide mobile-optimized breadcrumbs with an expandable "see more" button to conserve screen space
- Enable quick subcategory navigation via hover-triggered dropdown menus on desktop
- Support deep-linked URLs and SEO-friendly navigation structures

## Design Rationale

The component uses CSS-only responsive layout differences between mobile and desktop to prevent layout shifts during page load. On mobile, only the current and parent categories display initially, with truncation for long names on very small screens. The dropdown menus on desktop provide rapid access to sibling categories without requiring additional page loads.
shortDescription: Reflects canonical navigation path with each level (except current page) as a clickable link. On PDPs, current category remains clickable while product title is excluded. On small mobile screens, shows only current category with truncation for long names. Supports RTL languages and dynamically generates paths based on page taxonomy. Uses LuiText, LuiNavigationMenuTextItem, and LuiDropdown for rendering.
